RocksDB-backed accessors for root slots, shreds, and bank hashes in read-only backtest data.

# Purpose
`fd_backtest_rocksdb.c` implements a small RocksDB access layer for backtest data. It opens a RocksDB database in read-only mode with the column families `default`, `root`, `meta`, `data_shred`, and `bank_hashes`, then stores the database handle, read options, and an iterator in a shared-memory object. The file also defines the alignment, footprint, create, and join functions needed to place and validate the object in shared memory.

The remaining functions provide read access to backtest records by slot. [`fd_backtest_rocksdb_init`](<#fd_backtest_rocksdb_init>) positions the root iterator at a given root slot. [`fd_backtest_rocksdb_next_root_slot`](<#fd_backtest_rocksdb_next_root_slot>) advances through root slots and reads slot metadata from the `meta` column family to return the slot number and shred count. [`fd_backtest_rocksdb_shred`](<#fd_backtest_rocksdb_shred>) reads and validates a shred from `data_shred`, and [`fd_backtest_rocksdb_bank_hash`](<#fd_backtest_rocksdb_bank_hash>) reads and decodes the frozen bank hash from `bank_hashes`. The code uses RocksDB C APIs together with project decode helpers to convert stored binary records into typed data.
